note: INACTIVE. Nothing reads this file except `python -m market_data.news pilot-cycle`, which refuses live sources and bucket stores while active is false. Activation is a reviewed change by Owen, together with the storage choices below.

schedule.overlap: a cycle that finds the writer or publish lease held exits non-zero without writing; the next tick retries

launcher.note: The scheduled command is the bounded launcher (market_data/news/launch.py), not pilot-cycle directly: cycle_budget_s bounds collection only. deadline_s bounds the whole cycle process from the launcher's start (every phase, store call, SDK retry and subprocess). At the deadline the cycle is interrupted so its own failure handling releases its leases; after interrupt_grace_s it is killed (leases may then stay held until an operator breaks them). deadline_s + interrupt_grace_s + kill_wait_s (700 s) stays below interval_s and the 900 s lease TTL, so a launcher always ends before the next tick and never overlaps itself.

views.data_label: PILOT news: prices unavailable (no price input connected)

research.data_label: PREPARED research records (positioning / institutional pressure): not live collection
research.note: FIXED VIEW. Each cycle publishes one research page, built from the private research ledger (news/v1/research/, private store only), in research mode at that cycle's build cutoff, as a page of the same generation as the news views. The loader accepts no other mode or cutoff; more modes, a cutoff picker, adapters or live research sources are separate decisions.

private.holds: raw archive news/v1/runs/, news/v1/index/, news/v1/latest.json, leases, news/v1/publish/ state, head (news/v1/publish/head.json), commit records (news/v1/publish/commits/), snapshots and receipts
private.requirement: not publicly readable (no r2.dev or custom-domain access)

public.holds: sanitized view pages and index.json only
public.requirement: a dedicated public News bucket (never the shared market bucket), whose public origin is NEWS_R2_ORIGIN in backend/browser-data.js and NEWS_R2 in site/index.html (both null until provisioned); write credentials for this bucket only

retention.raw_archive: keep (immutable history); review at the end of the pilot
retention.public_views: the last views.days UTC dates, as immutable incarnations under news/v2/views/p/<gen>.<n>/; an incarnation's pages are deleted only once it has been out of the index for the reader grace (see generations), and never while a page upload into it is unanswered

generations.note: Owner-approved defaults (2026-11-12, G2 v2). A replaced generation stays public for at least reader_grace_s; deletion needs both the producer clock and the store clock to show reader_grace_s + clock_epsilon_s + clock_skew_s (49 min), agreeing within clock_skew_s. clock_epsilon_s is an ASSUMED store-clock bound that has not been verified for any provider, so clock_bound_verified stays false and expiry deletion is refused (reported by publish-status) until a deployment verifies it.
